reviews.title: Too much VIP
reviews.text: The game has too much VIP, also 8 quid for something I will use once a month and 3/4 of my favourite songs being VIP is Mental. I don’t get why someone playing for fun and just vibing to their favourite music would pay 8 pounds, also it’s for kids, not adult payments or something, the piano you can really use it full sized , every song has its own settings so. 1 star.
